text.div:
Cardiovascular Diseases

This value set contains terms related to cardiovascular diseases of any etiology. It includes a heterogeneous group of disorders related to the heart and blood vessels including coronary artery disease, cerebrovascular disease, venous disorders (e.g., thromboses, obstructions, malformations), and a variety of other conditions. Certain exceptions to the inclusion and/or exclusion criteria may exist for SNOMED CT due to its editorial policies for concept categorization.

Contains 10860 concept(s) from 3 code system(s).
